readers.program: GNUmakefile (make, while it parses the file)

entries.values: Any non-empty value counts as a CI run. The text is not parsed.

entries.default: Not applicable: the files of this area only set the variable.
entries.effect: Lets CMake accept third-party projects that declare an old cmake_minimum_required version (per the comment at flake.nix:1872).
entries.name: CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM
entries.notes: CMakePresets.json:24 and :51 set a cache variable with the same name to 3.5; that is not an environment variable.

setters.why: cmakeSandboxEnvironment
default, tools and cuda dev shells; the comment says CMake 4.x is stricter and that yaml-cpp 0.8.0 and drogon declare old minimum versions

entries.values: TRON sets the fixed text 3.5.

name: CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM
set_only_reader: third-party: cmake. The comment at flake.nix:1872-1873 says it is for CMake 4.x. No TRON reader. CMakePresets.json:24 and :51 also set the cache variable of the same name.

entries.default: Unset: TRON passes -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/lib/llvm-19 to the IWYU (include-what-you-use) external project (CMakeLists.txt:623).
entries.effect: When it is defined, TRON passes no CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH argument to the IWYU external project. The IWYU sub-build then uses the inherited variable.
entries.name: CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
entries.notes: The IWYU (include-what-you-use) external project is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL (CMakeLists.txt:646), so this matters only when the iwyu_external target is built. On Darwin the dev shell sets an empty string (flake.nix:1886). With the measured behaviour that still counts as defined, so TRON passes no -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH there.

readers.program: cmake configure of the root CMakeLists.txt

setters.value: colon-separated Nix store paths: llvm dev, clang dev, libunwind, tbb, openssl, jsoncpp, libuuid (function cmakePrefixPath, flake.nix:1126)
setters.why: cmakeSandboxEnvironment: cmake-sandbox dev shell, cmake-sandbox-configure check, tron-cmake-test-build derivation

setters.value: the same kind of list on Linux; an empty string on Darwin
setters.why: default, tools and cuda dev shells; the comment says the IWYU sub-build inherits it to find the LLVM and Clang package configs

entries.values: TRON tests only whether the variable is defined. TRON does not parse the text. An empty value counts as defined (measured with CMake 3.22.1 in a scratch test outside the checkout). CMake itself reads the value as a list of install prefixes.
